// Backup: Automatic daily database backup. SQL Express and LocalDB have no SQL Agent,
so this runs from inside the API. Path is on the SQL SERVER machine (that is
where BACKUP DATABASE runs) - if SQL is on another machine, give a path there.
Must be set to Enabled=true in production.
// ConnectionStrings: This points at the LOCAL database. Never keep the production connection string (with its password) in this file.
WHEN DEPLOYING TO PRODUCTION you MUST set this environment variable on the server,
otherwise the app will look for a local database and fail to start:

ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection = Data Source=<server>;Initial Catalog=<database>;User Id=<user>;Password=<password>;Encrypt=True;TrustServerCertificate=True;MultipleActiveResultSets=true;Connect Timeout=60;Max Pool Size=200;
An environment variable always wins over this file (ASP.NET Core handles that) - no code change needed.

ConnectionStrings.DefaultConnection: Data Source=<server>;Initial Catalog=<database>;User Id=<user>;Password=<password>;Encrypt=True;TrustServerCertificate=True;MultipleActiveResultSets=true;Connect Timeout=60;Max Pool Size=200;

Tenancy.// StrictMode: true = return 403 if the client sends an ownerId different from its own. The client always sends its own ownerId, so a mismatch means a bug or an attack. When false the value is corrected silently and only a warning is logged - security is the same either way, the difference is detection.

// Notification — Twilio se WhatsApp / S: Provider ke teen vikalp: 'Fast2SMS' (SMS), 'TwilioSMS', 'TwilioWhatsApp'.
WhatsApp chalu karne ke liye bas Provider ko 'TwilioWhatsApp' kar dein — baaki
kuch nahi badalna. Alert ka logic, wallet, credit ka kaatna, sab waisa hi rahega.
!! AUTH TOKEN ABHI IS FILE ME PADA HAI (2026-09-06, aapke kehne par, taaki local
par bina env var ke chal jaye). Wo asli chaabi hai — jiske paas hai wo AAPKE
Twilio account se, AAPKE paise par sandesh bhej sakta hai. Do kaam baaki:
1. Ye token chat me bheja ja chuka hai -> Twilio Console > Account >
API keys & tokens > Request secondary token > Promote to primary.
2. Naya token yahan NAHI, server par environment variable me dein aur
yahan wapas khaali string kar dein.
TWILIO KE TEEN VALUE (server par environment variable me, file me nahi):
Notification__Twilio_AccountSid  = AC...        (Twilio console se)
Notification__Twilio_AuthToken   = ...          (Twilio console se)
Notification__Twilio_FromNumber  = +14155238886 (WhatsApp sandbox ka number)
Env var hamesha is file se upar rehta hai, to server par ye file wali value
apne aap dab jayegi.
SHURU KARNE KA TARIKA (test ke liye, muft):
1. Twilio Console > Messaging > Try it out > Send a WhatsApp message
2. Wahan diye number par apne phone se 'join <code>' bhejein — aapka number
sandbox se jud jayega. Sandbox me sirf jude hue number par hi sandesh jaate hain.
3. Upar wale teen env var set karke Provider = TwilioWhatsApp kar dein.
ASLI KAAM KE LIYE: Twilio se apna WhatsApp sender approve karana padta hai
(Meta ki business verification). Tab tak SMS (Fast2SMS ya TwilioSMS) chalti rahegi.
NOTE: number ka format app khud theek karti hai — 10 ank wale number par +91
apne aap lag jaata hai.
TEMPLATE KI BAAT (asli kaam ke liye zaroori):
WhatsApp par do tarah ke sandesh hote hain —
* FREEFORM: seedha text. Sirf tab jaata hai jab grahak ne pichle 24 GHANTE me
aapko WhatsApp kiya ho. Test ke liye kaafi hai.
* TEMPLATE: pehle Meta se approve karana padta hai. Jab aap pehle sandesh
bhejte hain (jaise shift close ka alert) tab yahi chalega.
Pump ke alert hamesha hamari taraf se shuru hote hain, isliye asli kaam me
template hi chahiye. Approve hone ke baad uska ContentSid yahan dein:
Notification__Twilio_ContentSid = HX....
Set karte hi app template se bhejne lagegi; kuch aur nahi badalna.
Set na ho to freeform bhejti hai (test ke liye theek).
Twilio ne mana kiya to log me saaf wajah likhi aati hai (63016 = 24 ghante
wali khidki band, 21608 = trial me number verify nahi, 20003 = galat token).
